digest.component_or_area: reconciler backend facade and Jira adapter
propositions: A Backend facade with five role Protocols (TicketTransport, OutboundMapper, InboundMapper, FieldSanitizer, IdentityConvention) and RemoteRef dataclass must be defined and importable from _backend.py
JiraBackend must implement Backend as a thin delegation wrapper over existing Jira modules (acli.AcliClient, outbound_fields, inbound_fields) with zero behavior change
Three opt-in capability Protocols (SupportsLinks, SupportsComments, SupportsIncremental) must be runtime_checkable and detected via isinstance() rather than a capabilities() method

IdentityConvention must format and parse the rebar-id:{remote_id} label convention, extracting the embedded vendor/instance/remote_id into RemoteRef, serving as the single source of truth for the currently hand-inlined four core call sites

A backend-agnostic contract suite must pass when parameterized over both JiraBackend (with injected mock transport) and FakeBackend, covering round-trip field mapping, sanitizer idempotence, identity convention correctness, and capability-guarded dispatch

Characterization tests must verify byte-for-byte output identity of pure Jira mappers (_map_local_to_jira_fields, adf.fit_text_to_adf_limit, inbound extraction) against pre-story baseline, ensuring delegation fidelity without core module rewiring
